Forbidden.description: The role may not do this

Unauthorized.description: No valid session or API key

entries.description:
Entries; each string may hold several separated by commas,
spaces or newlines.

name.description: Required on create (the path names it on update).

source.description:
URL table / GeoIP / threat-feed source (type `geoip`, `urltable`
and `urltable_ports` fill it from `entries` when omitted).

AliasSource.description:
Where a self-filling alias gets its entries (table
`firewall_alias_sources`).

error.description: Human-readable message, in the language of the request (Accept-Language or the account's language).

network.description: a network id, or none / "all" for the unit-wide list

setup_code.description:
proof of ownership: the setup code (console / root-only file) or the
unit's existing root password

ChanInput.description: The same settings as optional API/UI input (absent = keep the old value, or the default for a new network).

password.description: Empty/absent on update = keep the stored one.

after.description: only events with an id above this (resume point)

action.description:
accept, drop (silently discard) or reject (TCP reset / ICMP
unreachable).

before.description: Create only: place the new rule just before rule `before`.

gateway.description:
Policy routing: a gateway or gateway group (Routing page) that
traffic this accept rule matches is sent through.

interface.description:
Inbound interface (outbound for the output chain): `any`, a role
(`@wan`, `@lan`, `@optN`, `@mgmt`) or a device name.

interface_out.description: Forward chain only: the outbound interface (`any` by default).

schedule.description: Name of a schedule; the rule is enforced only while it is active.

source.description: IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR, `any`, or `$alias` (host alias).

GatewayInput.description: A gateway as entered in the UI / API.

GeneralInput.description:
Fields of `PUT /api/system/general`; absent = unchanged, empty domain =
clear it.

mss_clamp.description: comma list of `@wan` / `@optN` / device; empty turns clamping off

HookSpec.description: A channel as entered in the UI / API.

InterfaceInput.description:
What the API / UI sends for a tunnel (missing fields keep their value
on edit).

regenerate_key.description: Replace the key pair (peers must get the new public key).

dhcp6_duid.description: Pinned DHCPv6 client DUID (hex bytes, colon separated); null = dhcpcd's own.

dhcp6_iaid.description: DHCPv6 IAID for IA_NA and IA_PD (the replaced router's, to keep its prefix); null = automatic.

force.description: Apply even if it may cut off the current management session.

metric.description: Route metric of the DHCP default route (lower = preferred uplink); null = the role's default.

pd_downstream.description: DHCPv6-PD (WAN, ipv6_mode dhcp6): interfaces that get a /64 slice

LanguageInfo.description: One language the UI and the API's messages are available in.

code.description: Language tag, as used in `Accept-Language` and the settings (`de`).

language.description:
A language tag with a catalog. Empty: for an account, back to the system default; for the
system default, back to the lower layers. The system default also takes `auto`.

LanguageOverview.description: The language settings as they apply to the caller.

current.description: The language this response is in.

system.description: The effective system default (`auto` = follow the browser).

system_stored.description:
What is stored for the system default (empty = not set; the environment, patronus.toml
or the built-in `auto` applies).

user.description: The signed-in account's own choice (empty = follows the system default).

totp_code.description: TOTP code (or a recovery code) for accounts with two-factor login.

destination.description:
Port forward: the external address to match (default: any
address on the interface).

interface.description:
Outbound interface for MASQUERADE/SNAT; inbound interface for a
port forward or 1:1 NAT (`@wan`, a device, or `any`).

protocol.description: tcp or udp (port forwards / port-limited outbound rules).

reflection.description: Port forward: NAT reflection (LAN clients may use the WAN address).

target.description:
`masquerade`, the SNAT address, the port-forward target
`address[:port]` (`[v6]:port`), or the internal address of a 1:1.

channel.description: a channel number, or `"auto"` (stored as 0; the default of a new network)

ids.description: Every non-system rule id, in the new order.

OverlayBody.description: Body for a GRE / GRE-TAP / VXLAN overlay link.

key.description: GRE key, or the VXLAN VNI (required for vxlan).

allowed_ips.description: Empty on create = the next free address(es) of the tunnel subnet.

preshared_key.description: true = generate a pre-shared key, false = remove it.

public_key.description:
The peer's public key. Empty on create = Patronus generates the
peer's key pair (a client whose config is exported from here).

daily_limit_minutes.description: `Some(None)` is spelled `0` in the API: no quota

blocklist_urls.description: URLs separated by space, comma or newline

password.description: Empty when editing = keep the stored password.

days.description: `mon`..`sun` (each string may hold a comma list).

base_dn.description:
LDAP: search start, search account, its password, user filter, TLS
mode (none | starttls | ldaps) and the group whose members are operators

SshInput.description:
Fields of `PUT /api/system/ssh`; absent = unchanged, empty = back to the
default / off.

lease_time.description: Seconds (120 s to 1 year); 0 = infinite; unset = the pool's.

conf.description: config file of the system dhcpcd; empty = the default

run_dir.description: run directory of the system dhcpcd; empty = the default

passphrase.description: non-empty = encrypt the backups with it

psk.description: Empty on create = generate one (shown once in the API answer).

password.description: EAP profiles: empty on create = generate one (shown once).

VlanBody.description: Body for VLAN / bond / bridge / PPPoE create-or-replace.

WebInput.description:
Fields of `PUT /api/system/web`: absent = unchanged, empty string = back
to the lower layers' value.

info.description: Everything the web UI does goes through this API. Authenticate with the session cookie of a signed-in browser, or with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-API-Key`), created under System > API keys. Calls that change configuration need an account or key whose role may modify it (read-only roles get 403). Operations marked `x-api-keys-allowed: false` are for people only. Error bodies are `{"error": "..."}`, translated into the request language.
info.summary: Management API of the Patronus router and firewall
info.title: Patronus API

post.description:
POST /api/system/users/:id/2fa/reset (admin): turn the account's
two-factor login off (lost phone).

Not for the admin's *own* account: `POST /api/auth/2fa/disable` asks for
the password and a current code (throttled like login), and this route
would let anyone holding an admin's session strip the owner's second
factor without either. An admin locked out of their own 2FA isn't
logged in anyway; that is what `patronus users reset-2fa` is for.
post.summary: Turn the account's two-factor login off (lost phone).

put.description:
PUT /api/system/web -- listen addresses, HTTPS port, HTTP redirect port
(0 = off), extra HTTPS ports ("none" = off), TLS certificate/key paths.
Absent = unchanged, empty = back to the lower layers, `reset` = forget all.
The firewall's anti-lockout rule follows at once; the listeners move when
the web UI is restarted (the answer says so), so a wrong value can be
corrected from the old address first.
put.summary: Listen addresses, HTTPS port, HTTP redirect port (0 = off), extra HTTPS ports ("none" = off), TLS certificate/key paths.
